# Writing rules for comments

This is a starter summary in the style of ASD-STE100. It is not the
specification. Replace it with the rules and dictionary from your copy
of the specification (free on request from asd-ste100.org).

## Words
1. Use a word with one meaning only. Use the same word for the same thing each time.
2. Use a word as one part of speech only (for example, "test" as a noun, not as a verb, if the dictionary says so).
3. Prefer the simple, common word: "use" not "utilize", "stop" not "terminate", "before" not "prior to", "start" not "commence".
4. Do not use slang, idioms, or figures of speech.
5. Do not use contractions.
6. Do not use noun clusters longer than three words.
7. Use an article ("the", "a", "an") or a demonstrative before a noun where English requires one.

## Verbs
8. Use only these forms: infinitive, imperative, simple present, simple past, simple future.
9. Do not use the "-ing" form of a verb, except as part of a technical name.
10. Do not use the past participle with "have" (no perfect tenses).
11. Use the active voice. Use the passive only when the agent is unknown.
12. Do not use phrasal verbs when a single approved verb exists.

## Sentences
13. Write one topic per sentence.
14. Write one instruction per sentence, unless two actions occur at the same time.
15. Start a condition with "if" or "when" and put it before the instruction.
16. Do not omit words to make a sentence shorter.
(Sentence length is checked by the script. Do not report it.)

## Approved technical names
Identifiers, rune names, and these project terms are permitted as written:

- FOIL, Shrine, enki, PLAN
- pin, pail, rune, aura, namespace
- (add your own)
